uyeler.baslik: Euro Bölgesi’nde kamu borcu GSYH’nin yüzde 88,8’ine yükseldi
uyeler.ozet: Euro Bölgesi’nde kamu borcunun GSYH’ye oranı 2026’nın ikinci çeyreğinde yüzde 88,8’e yükseldi. AB’nin en borçlu ülkesi Yunanistan’a yaklaşan İtalya’da borç oranı artarken, Fransa’da kamu borcu GSYH’nin yüzde 119,1’ine ulaştı ve ülkenin borçlanma maliyetleri yüzde 5’i aştı. Avrupa Birliği’nin (AB) istatistik kurumu Eurostat’ın çarşamba günü açıkladığı verilere göre, Euro Bölgesi’ndeki 21 ülkenin toplam kamu borcunun ekonomik büyüklüklerine oranı, nisan-haziran döneminde yüzde 88,8’e ulaştı. Bu oran, geçen yılın aynı döneminde yüzde 87,3 seviyesindeydi. Borç/GSYH oranı, hükümetlerin toplam borcunu ülkelerin ekonomik büyüklüğüyle karşılaştırıyor.

Images of the riots, which began as peaceful student protests before getting out of control, were posted and broadcast around the world. School blockades this month on Saturday morphed into wider upheaval and pockets of violence by some youths over issues such as the rising cost of living. But some tourists in Paris seem relatively unperturbed by the violent scenes of looting and clashes with police. Eliana Chanez, visiting from Louisiana in the United States, said the chaos over the weekend did not stop her from enjoying the city.

uyeler.ozet: The alleged participation of US agents in an April drug operation has raised questions about whether Mexican law was upheld. Mexico has taken the rare step of charging a former state prosecutor with treason, alleging that he allowed United States agents to take part in a drug raid on the country’s territory. The case underscores sensitivities about US involvement in Mexico and concerns about the Latin American country’s sovereignty. Under Mexican law, the federal government must approve the activities of foreign forces on the country’s soil. uyeler.baslik: Mexico ex-prosecutor charged with treason over US drug raid
uyeler.ozet: Federal prosecutors in Mexico have charged a former state prosecutor with treason for allowing US agents to join a raid on a suspected drugs lab in April without proper authorisation. César Jáuregui Moreno served as attorney general of the northern border state of Chihuahua from 2023 to this year. The involvement of Americans came to light after two US agents said to have worked for the CIA died in a car crash in Chihuahua along with two Mexican law enforcement officers. Attorney General Ernestina Godoy Ramos said Jáuregui had allowed foreign agents to carry out activities reserved for Mexican authorities and had failed to share information. Jáuregui has denied the allegations.

uyeler.baslik: Vance tells Republicans to 'stop whining' about Ohio attack ad against Democrat Amy Acton
uyeler.ozet: US Vice-President JD Vance has urged fellow Republicans to stop "whining" about a controversial attack ad that featured a Democratic candidate's estranged mother calling her a liar. While campaigning in Ohio for Vivek Ramaswamy, the Republican candidate for governor, Vance said he was "a little bit disgusted" by criticism from members of his own party. In the ad, Donna Arthur, the mother of Democratic candidate Amy Acton, said her daughter "lied her entire life". It does not mention that Arthur's husband was charged with raping Acton when she was a child. The Ramaswamy campaign have claimed credit for the ad, and have paid millions to have it advertised around the state.

uyeler.baslik: Key Ohio Republicans criticize Ramaswamy’s ad with Acton’s estranged mother, even as Vance warned them not to
uyeler.ozet: Some leading Ohio Republicans began distancing themselves from a controversial new ad from their gubernatorial nominee, Vivek Ramaswamy, even as Vice President JD Vance warned the party not to break ranks over the commercial. “I would not have run that ad,” Sen. Jon Husted, who is in one of the country’s most competitive Senate races, said in a statement to the Associated Press published shortly after Husted appeared at a Cincinnati rally with Vance and Ramaswamy. The Ramaswamy ad has drawn bipartisan criticism for featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Amy Acton. In the video, Acton’s mother called her daughter a liar and urged voters not to support her.

uyeler.baslik: Pope Leo XIV needs no further lung cancer treatment, Vatican says

The pontiff underwent surgery last week to remove part of his right lung after being diagnosed with adenocarcinoma. He was discharged Saturday and will gradually resume activities. Leo, 71, had the lower lobe of his right lung removed last week in the first major health event of his 17-month pontificate. The surgery confirmed he had adenocarcinoma, the most common type of lung cancer.

Müslüman ülkeler arasında savunma alanında artan iş birliği, akıllara ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın ilk görev döneminde gündeme gelen "Arap NATO'su" planını getirdi. Plan, kamuoyuna ilk kez Mayıs 2017'de duyuruldu.

As of 9.50 am local time (0650GMT), the lira traded at 49.6270 against the US dollar, 55.9090 against the euro and 66.6430 against the British pound. Gold was priced at $4,089.90 per ounce, while Brent crude oil futures stood at $111.55 per barrel.

uyeler.baslik: Russia frees jailed American Stephen Hubbard
uyeler.ozet: Russian President Vladimir Putin announced the release of US captive Stephen Hubbard during talks with US special envoy Steve Witkoff in St. Petersburg on Wednesday. Hubbard had been taken captive by Russian forces on charges of being a mercenary, which he denies. He was sentenced to seven years in prison at a closed trial in 2024. Putin said Hubbard was at the airport and Witkoff said he was now "going home to his family." US President Donald Trump later said he had made the request directly to Putin during a phone call last week.

The announcement came as US envoy Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg, discussing the war in Ukraine and efforts to secure a peace deal. Hubbard, a Michigan native, was sentenced to nearly seven years in prison following a closed trial in 2024.

Kliçko ayrıca, saldırılarda Pivdennyi Köprüsü’ndeki metro altyapısının zarar gördüğünü ve bunun kentin bazı bölgeleri arasındaki ulaşımı kısıtladığını açıkladı.

uyeler.baslik: Elon Musk, Tesla ve SpaceX’i neden birleştirmek istiyor?
uyeler.ozet: Elon Musk’ın Tesla ve SpaceX’i 3,5 trilyon dolarlık bir şirkette birleştirmeyi değerlendirdiği, anlaşmanın Trump’ın görev süresi sona ermeden tamamlanmasının hedeflendiği bildirildi. Dünyanın en zengin insanı bu hafta Tesla ile SpaceX'in olası bir birleşmeyi incelediğini doğruladı. İki şirketin toplam değeri yaklaşık 3,5 trilyon dolar (3,1 trilyon euro) ve bu da anlaşmayı tarihin en büyük birleşmesi haline getirebilir. Bu adım, Elon Musk'ın şirketlerini birbirine bağlayan bir dizi anlaşmanın son halkası olabilir. Bloomberg'in, konuyu bilen kaynaklara dayandırdığı haberine göre hedef, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump hâlâ görevdeyken birleşmeyi tamamlamak.

uyeler.baslik: 2035 medyası için karanlık senaryo: Gazeteci sayısı yarıya inebilir
uyeler.ozet: Almanya'da kamu yayın kuruluşları ARD ve ZDF ile Deutschlandradio'nun yaptırdığı bir araştırma, yapay zekâ ve teknoloji devlerinin önümüzdeki on yılda medyaya etkisine dair senaryoları mercek altına aldı. Köln Teknik Üniversitesi'nden medya araştırmacısı Christian Zabel ile Tallinn Üniversitesi'nden Ulrike Rohn tarafından hazırlanan raporda dört senaryo ortaya çıktı. Değişik senaryolara göre profesyonel gazetecilerin sayısının 2035'e kadar yüzde 12 ila yüzde 50 oranında azalması bekleniyor. Almanya'da 2023 yılı itibarıyla yaklaşık 40 bin profesyonel gazeteci bulunuyor. En kötü senaryoda bu sayı 2035'te yaklaşık 20 bine düşecek.

uyeler.baslik: First human case of Shamonda virus detected in France, officials say
uyeler.ozet: The first known human case of the Shamonda virus (Shav) has been detected in a patient who died in early October, French authorities have said. Health officials said it was an "exceptional case in a severely immunocompromised patient" and there was currently no risk to the public. Shav is a disease that primarily affects cattle and can be spread by infected midges. Cases have also occurred in sheep, goats, alpacas and horses, but infections in people were previously unheard of. The World Health Organization (WHO) and European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) said they were monitoring the situation, with French officials still investigating how the virus had spread to a human.

uyeler.baslik: İlk kez insana bulaşan Shamonda virüsü Fransa'da can aldı

Yetkililer, mevcut bilgilere göre, virüsün genel nüfus açısından risk oluşturmadığını belirtti. Sivrisinekler aracılığıyla hayvanlara bulaşan Shamonda virüsü, ilk kez 1960'lı yılların ortasında Nijerya'da görüldü. Virüs, sonraki yıllarda Batı, Doğu ve Güney Afrika'nın yanı sıra Japonya'da da sığırlarda ortaya çıktı.

uyeler.ozet: Ukrayna'nın Rusya'daki veri merkezlerine düzenlediği İHA saldırıları, ülkenin dijital hizmetlerinde ciddi aksamalara yol açtı. Uzmanlar, Rusya'nın yapay zeka geliştirme hedeflerinin sekteye uğrayabileceğini belirtiyor. Rusya-Ukrayna savaşında beşinci yılına yaklaşılırken, saldırıların yeni hedeflerinden biri veri merkezleri. Ukrayna bu ay Rus teknoloji devi Yandex'e ait üç veri merkezinin yanı sıra ülkenin en büyük bankası Sberbank ve sosyal medya platformu VKontakte'nin (VK) kullandığı tesislere İHA saldırıları düzenledi. Saldırıların ardından Rusya genelinde bulut bilişim, bankacılık, e-ticaret, navigasyon ve taksi çağırma hizmetlerinde kesintiler bildirildi.

uyeler.baslik: Vatandaşın rotası değişti: Hangi yatırım aracı tercih ediliyor?
uyeler.ozet: TCMB’nin Hanehalkı Beklenti Anketi’ne göre, yatırım tercihini altından yana kullanacağını belirtenlerin oranı yüzde 43,3’e, ev, dükkân veya arsa almayı düşünenlerin oranı yüzde 35,6’ya yükseldi. Borsaya yatırım yapacağını söyleyenlerin oranı ise bir ayda yüzde 3,2’den yüzde 1,8’e geriledi. Sonuçlar, yanıtların toplulaştırılmasıyla elde edildi. Demografik kırılımlara bakıldığında, 12 ay sonrası enflasyon beklentisi eylül ayına göre tüm gruplarda geriledi. Kadınların enflasyon beklentisi yüzde 47,0'den yüzde 45,0'e, erkeklerin beklentisi ise yüzde 44,6'dan yüzde 42,8'e indi.

uyeler.baslik: Fransa yeniden daralmaya giriyor, Avrupa’nın büyümesi yavaşlıyor: Ne kadar kötüleşebilir?
uyeler.ozet: Fransa'da özel sektör bu ay daralma gösterdi; bu durum, siyasi belirsizlik ve yüksek enerji maliyetleri nedeniyle euro bölgesinde iş dünyası faaliyet artışını son dört ayın en düşük seviyesine çekti. Fransa’nın büyümeye dönüşü yalnızca bir ay sürdü. Ekim ayında ekonomik faaliyet yeniden daralırken, Fransız şirketlerinin güveni 2020’deki ilk Covid-19 kapanmalarından bu yana en düşük seviyesine indi. Bu düşüş, daha geniş euro bölgesini de aşağı çekti. İmalat ve hizmet sektörlerindeki faaliyeti ölçen euro bölgesi bileşik satın alma yöneticileri endeksi (PMI), eylülde 53,1 iken ekimde 51,9’a geriledi.

uyeler.baslik: Kılıçdaroğlu: CHP'nin hesabındaki 5 milyon Yeni Parti'ye aktarıldı, para ödenmezse suç duyurusunda bulunacağız
uyeler.ozet: Mutlak butlan kararı ardından CHP Genel Başkanı olarak atanan Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, partisinin banka hesabındaki 5 milyon 100 bin TL'nin Yeni Parti'ye aktarıldığını öne sürdü. Kılıçdaroğlu, Yeni Parti'ye resmi ihtarname gönderdiklerini ve para ödenmezse suç duyurusunda bulunacaklarını söyledi. uyeler.baslik: Betimar anket: Erdoğan'ın oy oranı en yakın rakibinin iki katını aştı; AKP ve Yeni Parti'nin oy oranları yüzde kaç?

Üçüncü sıraya yerleşen DEM Parti'nin oy oranı yüzde 10 oldu. MHP'nin oy oranı yüzde 7,7, CHP'nin oy oranı ise yüzde 4,8 olarak ölçüldü. Cumhurbaşkanlığı anketinde Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, yüzde 30,4 ile birinci sırada yer aldı.

uyeler.baslik: Turkish stock exchange opens Friday higher
uyeler.ozet: Türkiye’s benchmark BIST 100 index opened Friday at 11,234.39 points, up 0.12% or 14.02 points from the previous close. The index had closed Thursday down 3.08% at 11,220.37 points, with a daily transaction volume of 111 billion liras ($2.24 billion). As of 09.50 am local time (0650GMT), the lira traded at 49.7375 against the US dollar, 55.8065 against the euro, and 66.6325 against the British pound. Gold was priced at $4,014.20 per ounce, while Brent crude oil futures stood at $114.28 per barrel.

uyeler.baslik: TRNC welcomes Libyan parliament's approval of maritime jurisdiction agreement with Türkiye
uyeler.ozet: The Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC) on Friday welcomed the Libyan House of Representatives' approval of the memorandum of understanding on the delimitation of maritime jurisdiction areas between Türkiye and Libya, which has been in force since 2019. The ministry said the TRNC fully supports, in solidarity, Turkiye's vision of establishing peace, security and stability in the Mediterranean basin. "We welcome this historic step, which is shaped on the basis of international law and the principles of equity and reflects the realities of the region," the statement said.

uyeler.baslik: Türkiye, Canada sign deal to strengthen export credit cooperation
uyeler.ozet: Türkiye and Canada signed a memorandum of understanding to strengthen export credit cooperation and support joint projects in third-country markets, Turkish Trade Minister Omer Bolat said Friday. The agreement between Turk Eximbank and Export Development Canada (EDC) followed Bolat's meeting with Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand in Istanbul. In a statement on Turkish social media platform NSosyal, Bolat said the two discussed expanding bilateral trade and economic relations, alongside negotiations on a Türkiye-Canada free trade agreement. He welcomed plans to hold the first round of free trade negotiations during the week beginning Nov. 30, 2026.

uyeler.baslik: OPEC Fund approves record $250M loan for Istanbul North Rail Crossing
uyeler.ozet: The OPEC Fund for International Development has approved a $250 million loan for the Istanbul North Rail Crossing project, marking the largest single financing commitment in the institution’s history. uyeler.baslik: AYM’de başkanlık yarışı: Üç ismin Can Atalay-Tayfun Kahraman ortaklığı
uyeler.ozet: Mart 2024'den bu yana Anayasa Mahkemesi (AYM) başkanlığı koltuğunda oturan Kadir Özkaya'nınAYM'deki 12 yıllık üyelik süresi 22 Aralık 2026’da sona eriyor. uyeler.baslik: Mohammed Salah çılgınlığı Trabzon'a nasıl yansıyor?
uyeler.ozet: Mohammed Salah geçen sezon sonunda Liverpool'dan ayrılacağını açıkladığında, yeni adresinin Arabistan Yarımadası'nda olabileceğini düşünenlerin sayısı az değildi. Onu belki de ülkelerinde bir stadyumda izlemeyi hayal eden Arap futbolseverlerden bazılarıysa bugün Trabzon'a kalkan uçaklara biniyor. Kulüp tarihinin tartışmasız en büyük transferi Salah, bu yıl henüz Süper Lig'de çıktığı sekiz maçta sekiz kez fileleri havalandırdı. Avrupa'da, Konferans Ligi'nde de Trabzon'u nereye kadar taşıyabileceğine dair iddialar çeşitli. Trabzon kentinde ise yalnızca saha içi değil saha dışı hareketleri de büyük ilgiyle takip ediliyor.

uyeler.baslik: Erdoğan'ın Aliyev'i araması Azerbaycan'da nasıl yorumlandı?
uyeler.ozet: Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, çarşamba günü Azerbaycan Cumhurbaşkanı İlham Aliyev ile telefonda görüştü. Azerbaycan medyası, görüşmeyi iki ülke arasındaki stratejik ortaklığın ve karşılıklı güvenin teyidi olarak değerlendirdi. Görüşme, Azerbaycan hükümetinin aynı gün 31 Türkiye vatandaşını "istenmeyen kişi" ilan ederek ülkeye girişlerini yasaklamasının ardından gerçekleşti. Azerbaycan'da hükümetin kontrolündeki bazı medya kuruluşları telefon görüşmesini "gecikmiş" bir adım olarak nitelendirse de gelişmeyi memnuniyetle karşıladı. Ancak bu kuruluşlar, son krizin tehditlere karşı daha hızlı ve etkili işbirliğinin önemini ortaya koyduğunu da belirtti.

uyeler.baslik: İstanbul’da bir belediye daha Yeni Parti’ye geçti
uyeler.ozet: Maltepe Belediye Başkanı Esin Köymen, CHP’den istifa ederek Yeni Parti’ye katıldığını açıkladı. Köymen, “Bundan sonraki siyasi yolculuğumda da demokrasiye, laikliğe, hukukun üstünlüğüne, emeğe ve halkın iradesine bağlılıkla Maltepe halkı için çalışmaya devam edeceğim” dedi. Sosyal medya hesabından yaklaşık bir dakikalık video paylaşan Köymen, Yeni Parti’ye katılma gerekçelerini anlattı. Köymen, Kadıköy Belediye Başkanı Mesut Kösedağı’nın ardından İstanbul’da Yeni Parti’ye katılan ikinci ilçe belediye başkanı oldu.

uyeler.ozet: BIST 100 endeksi 23 Ekim’de 11 bin puanın altına gerilerken, haftayı da düşüşle tamamlaması halinde üst üste altı haftalık kayıp kaydedecek. The storm was about 220 km east of Taiwan, the CWA said. The storm’s forecast track shows it will pass just off northeastern Taiwan, turn north toward the Chinese coast and eventually move into southern Japan. uyeler.baslik: Taiwan: Deadly Typhoon Champi brings travel chaos and school closures
uyeler.ozet: In Keelung, enormous waves crashed against the shore, while emergency workers cleared fallen branches and debris from streets in the capital. One person was killed after being swept away by waves on Liuqiu island on Thursday, while 94 others were injured. Schools and offices closed, while 931 flights were cancelled, including all 262 domestic services and 669 international flights. At Taipei's Songshan Airport, departure counters stood empty and stranded passengers rested beneath screens displaying cancellations. Champi had weakened from peak sustained winds of 298 km/h earlier in the week to 155 km/h as it approached Taiwan.

uyeler.baslik: Taiwan shuts down schools and businesses as Typhoon Champi approaches
uyeler.ozet: As Typhoon Champi approached Taiwan, most businesses and schools were closed across the island Friday and hundreds of flights were canceled in the region. Authorities reported at least one death and dozens of injuries and more than 1,200 people have evacuated their homes. The typhoon is expected to sweep past Taiwan's northeast as it moves towards China and Japan, triggering the cancellation of hundreds of flights in the region. At least one person has been killed in Taiwan after being swept away by waves whipped up by the typhoon, authorities said. Dozens of others have been injured.

uyeler.baslik: Typhoon Champi: Hundreds of flights cancelled as storm shuts Taiwan
uyeler.ozet: Hundreds of flights in the East Asia region were cancelled on Friday as powerful Typhoon Champi roared close to Taiwan's north-east coast. Schools and offices in Taiwan were shut as Champi neared the island. While it is uncertain if it will make landfall, the storm was forecast to bring 90cm (35in) of rain and strong winds to the north-east until Saturday. One person died after being swept away by waves, authorities said. The storm also injured 171 people and forced 1,000 others to evacuate.

uyeler.baslik: 7-magnitude earthquake hits Tibet, killing 16 and injuring dozens, Chinese state media reports
uyeler.ozet: At least 16 people have died and dozens were injured after a magnitude 7 earthquake struck Tibet on Thursday, according to Chinese state news agency Xinhua. The epicenter was 183 kilometers East-Northeast of the city of Nagqu in the Tibet region, according to the United States Geological Survey. At least 339 houses have collapsed and the extent of the damage is still being assessed, according to Xinhua. A rescue team has been dispatched to the epicenter. Railway authorities have suspended train services through the affected areas, according to state media CCTV.

uyeler.baslik: 7-magnitude earthquake strikes China’s Tibet
uyeler.ozet: BEIJING – A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck China’s southwestern region of Tibet at around 10.33pm on Oct 22, the China Earthquake Networks Centre (CENC) said. Local authorities have found at least two people injured in a village near the epicentre, with some houses in villages closest to the epicentre showing cracks, the state broadcaster said. The quake is the strongest to hit China since January 2024. The epicentre was in a sparsely populated, high-altitude county in Nagqu, northern Tibet, at a depth of 10km. The average elevation within 5km of the epicentre is about 4,864m, CENC data showed.

The China Earthquake Administration activated a Level-II emergency response as rescue operations got under way. A magnitude 7 earthquake has killed at least 16 people in China’s Tibet Autonomous Region. Search and rescue efforts were continuing on Friday after the quake, whose epicentre was in a remote region of northern Tibet, struck at 10:33pm (14:33 GMT) on Thursday. A level-II earthquake disaster emergency response was activated in the area, the Xinhua news agency said. Electricity and communication lines were down.

More than 300 houses collapsed in the earthquake, which struck Thursday at 10:33pm (1433 GMT). Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, Xinhua said.

The county - located in what China calls the Tibet Autonomous Region after annexing it in the 1950s - is 400km (250 miles) north-east of the region's capital, Lhasa. uyeler.ozet: China ordered an “all-out” rescue effort in Tibet on Friday after an earthquake killed at least 16 people, injured dozens and flattened hundreds of homes, state media reported. Diners ran out of restaurants and items fell off wobbling supermarket shelves as the tremor struck, according to clips on state broadcaster CCTV, which said 65 people were injured. uyeler.baslik: Nigeria's health minister says first Ebola case remains isolated
uyeler.ozet: Nigeria’s health minister Muhammad Ali Pate said that the country’s first confirmed Ebola case remains "contained" with no evidence that it has spread into the wider community. The 42-year-old patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat based in Abuja. She had been on holiday in Kampala for two weeks before travelling back to Nigeria. Speaking on Thursday, he said she is in a stable condition and “is recovering”. "Today, I spoke to the clinicians, and I understand that her lab results are showing great improvement and there's a possibility that she would recover from this," said Pate.

uyeler.ozet: Switzerland's foreign ministry has confirmed that the woman who has tested positive for Ebola in Nigeria is the wife of a Swiss diplomat. The woman, a 42-year-old Ugandan-born national who lives in the Nigerian capital, Abuja, tested positive for the virus on 20 October, becoming the country's first confirmed Ebola patient in more than a decade. They both travelled to Uganda earlier this month. Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms, according to the Swiss foreign ministry. The ministry told the BBC that all 25 staff at its embassy in Nigeria were in good health and did not need to isolate.

uyeler.baslik: Albania: Parliament descends into chaos as MPs clash over protests
uyeler.ozet: MPs pushed and shoved one another, tore microphones from desks and threw objects across the chamber. Opposition members blocked the podium and banged on desks in an attempt to disrupt proceedings, while other lawmakers continued voting on legislation by raising their cards. Footage showed overturned chairs and repeated confrontations between rival politicians as tensions escalated inside the assembly. The clashes unfolded against the backdrop of student demonstrations that have gripped the Albanian capital for ten consecutive days. Opposition lawmakers held up photographs of students reportedly injured by police during earlier protests, expressing solidarity with the demonstrators.

uyeler.ozet: The Turkish foreign minister warned on Friday that a new attack on Iran would further spread war and conflict across the region. “Military intervention in Iran is by no means a solution. uyeler.baslik: Argentina drops investigation into Milei over crypto fraud
uyeler.ozet: A criminal investigation into Argentine President Javier Milei and his sister's links to a cryptocurrency scandal has been dropped. The case against Milei and his sister Karina Milei was dismissed by federal judge Marcelo Martinez de Giorgi at the request of prosecutors, court records show. The Argentinian president had denied promoting the newly launched cryptocoin $Libra, which collapsed shortly after he mentioned it in a social media post in February 2025. He said he had acted "in good faith" when the cryptocurrency rose in value, before crashing and causing huge losses for the majority of its investors. Milei is yet to respond to news of the case being dropped.

Macron said the attack was a "turning point in the life of our Republic and our nation" - the first time there had ever been a random racial killing like this. The attack unfolded over some 15 minutes, with the attacker opening fire from his car - first in Trappes, to the south-west of Paris, and then in nearby La Verrière - appearing to target people of migrant origin. He was subsequently arrested. Three of those injured, including a 12-year-old girl, remain in a serious condition.

uyeler.baslik: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan, killing one and injuring hundreds
uyeler.ozet: Authorities warn of ‘destructive winds’ and urge residents to shelter as the storm passes the island’s northeast. Typhoon Champi has struck Taiwan, killing one person and injuring more than 500 others, as authorities warned of “destructive winds” and instructed people to stay indoors. The storm swept past the island’s northeast on Friday, toppling trees, triggering brief flooding, disrupting power lines and forcing more than 5,000 people to evacuate from their homes. Most shops in northern and central Taiwan stayed shut for a second day as the storm edged away from the northeast and headed north. Champi is heading towards China and Japan, forcing flight cancellations in the region.

Çakmak ile aynı gün tutuklanan önemli isimlerden biri de Altınbaş Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı İnan Altınbaş oldu. Taha Çakmak bu soruşturmada 14 Ekim'de ilk kez ifade vermişti. Gazeteci İsmail Saymaz'a konuşan Çakmak, gecelik değerlendirmek için Türkiye Sigorta A.Ş'nin 100 milyon TL'sini Tera fonuna koyduğunu doğrulamıştı. Taha Çakmak, daha önce Merkez Bankası başkan yardımcılığı ve Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (BDDK) başkan yardımcılığı yapmıştı.

uyeler.baslik: Trump’s threat to strike Iran raises public concerns, congressional questions
uyeler.ozet: President Donald Trump has renewed his threat of military action against Iran, raising questions about public support for the war and Congress’s ability to restrain further escalation. With midterm elections approaching on November 3, polls show widespread dissatisfaction with the war, particularly over rising fuel prices and the risk to American troops. Reports of renewed US-Israeli military planning have also raised concerns about possible strikes after the elections. Trump made his latest threat at a rally in Florida on Friday. “We may do another little Epic Fury,” he said, referring to the US military operation against Iran.

Münih'te Hristiyan Sosyal Birlik (CSU) kongresine katılan Merz, buradaki konuşmasında, SPD ve Yeşillerin "bu aşırı solcu parti ile hükümet kurmak istemesinin ağır bir yük olacağını" savundu. Sağ popülist Başbakan Andrej Babis liderliğindeki koalisyon, kamu yayınlarını doğrudan devlet bütçesinden finanse etmeyi planlıyor.
